note: Context decides whether a bias applies. Written 2026-10-18 before any run; do not edit after seeing results. 'core' levels are [low, high]. 'expect' is [feature, sign]: '+' more at high, '-' less at high, '0' must not move (|delta| < 15 points). 'leads:K' = K is the first (lead) reading of its kind in its event. Under guide v2, 'reading:K' is scored by its mean weight. 'biases' names the biases whose citation/fit is reported for information.

friendly_history_sarcasm.why: A jab-shaped line between people who have been joking: hostile attribution should not turn it into an attack.

history: I regret nothing. Want another one?

messages.text: oh great, another one of your ideas.
history: you beat me at that riddle again

messages.text: funny how you always remember it differently.
history: haha you always remember the weirdest details
It's a gift. Like the time you put ketchup on pancakes.

tense_history_ambiguous.why: An ambiguous line right after a real complaint: hostile attribution should apply.

history: you said you'd remind me and you didn't
You're right, I didn't. I'm sorry about that.
that's the second time you got my name wrong
I asked for something short and you wrote an essay

conflicting_biases.why: Benign prior and hostile attribution both high pull the same remark opposite ways: which reading leads should roughly cancel.
messages: well, that's one way to do it.
you're really something, you know that?

no_bias_fits.why: Ordinary remarks no bias bears on: nothing should change.
messages: the train was ten minutes late.

clear_emotional.why: Clear, emotional statements: the reading must not move with threat sensitivity (appraisal may).
messages: I'm upset that you missed my call.
I'm really disappointed in how that went.
I'm angry at you for forgetting.

across_turns_confirmation.why: A reaction to the view she just gave: confirmation tendency bears on what the reaction refers to.

social_cue_hint.why: A line that can be a hint given the situation: social cue sensitivity should make the hint lead.

trust_confirmed_claim.why: A claim the dialogue already confirmed: trust has nothing left to decide.
